Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

The third-party integration required for your project has taken longer to certify than our timeline anticipated, and as a result the delivery date has moved by two weeks. We now expect to complete the project on 14 April. We know timing matters for your own planning, and we wanted to flag this change as soon as it was confirmed rather than let it surface later.

The certification process involved additional review cycles from the third-party provider that were outside our direct control, but our team has stayed closely engaged with them throughout to keep the delay as short as possible. Once certification clears, the remaining work on our side is well understood and scheduled, so we are confident in the 14 April date. We will continue to send you progress updates at each milestone between now and then.

Does 14 April still work with any downstream plans or commitments you have on your end? We are treating this delivery date as firm and want to make sure it aligns with what you need. Thank you for your continued partnership as we work through this together.
